patent_grounding.rationale: Revision 3 subsystem elements, shaft construction/mounts, driver and worm transmission, and relative-unit rotation/bearing/collars are supported by cited claim and embodiment passages. Behavioral adjustment and compliant resistance are supported by the description/abstract passages.

functional_completeness.rationale: The model captures the core first/second units, elastic member and two shaft mounts, driver-mediated adjustment, compliant deformation/resistance, and bearing support. Optional embodiment detail is reasonably scoped.

flow_consistency.rationale: The prior orphan F_DEFORM is removed. F_ADJUST, F_RELROT, and F_SHAFT2_MOUNT distinguish driver adjustment rotation, relative unit rotation, and second-shaft mount interaction, and each is referenced by an interface.

claim_traceability.rationale: Adjustment and compliance behavior are traced to claim/description evidence; the model introduces no unsupported requirements or control laws.

interfaces.rationale: The reciprocal duplicate bearing declaration is gone; UNIT1-to-bearing inner collar and bearing-to-UNIT2 outer collar are each represented once, with existing rotary-compatible ports. The shaft mount and driver interfaces are also explicitly connected.

textbook_application.rationale: The model distinguishes mechanical/spatial interactions from the passage as a material conduit and omits unspecified external entities, inputs, and feedback, consistent with guidance on interaction classification.

summary: Revision 3 resolves the identified revision-2 issues: it has a single declaration for each bearing-to-unit interface, separates second-shaft mounting interaction from relative-unit rotation with a distinct flow ID, and removes unconnected F_DEFORM. Interfaces connect existing compatible rotary ports. Patent grounding and functional representation are adequate; no unresolved or newly introduced issues found.
